title: Mom Murders Woman in Front of 5 Kids in Christmas Custody Dispute
description:
On Christmas Day, a custody exchange exploded into chaos in the parking lot of a Florida Walgreens. Security cameras captured the moment Amanda Janzen, 38, allegedly opened fire, hitting a woman and the father of his infant child. Janzen, with five children in tow, fled the scene, triggering a dangerous 13-mile high-speed chase with police. Watch the chilling bodycam footage and witness accounts as police piece together the tragic events of this holiday homicide on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
